## Objective

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Approved scope

Link the relevant approved decision or state that this PR is a proposal awaiting approval.

## Changes and files

List the significant changes and affected files.

## Verification and results

List only checks actually executed, their results, and any checks not performed. Provide reproduction instructions where useful.

## Impact and risks

Describe compatibility, security, rights, accessibility, and operational implications as applicable.

## UI evidence

For UI changes, link approved mockups and actual desktop/mobile screenshots. Describe visual and interaction checks and unresolved deviations. Otherwise state "Not applicable".

## Founder review

- [ ] The change stays within approved scope, or unapproved proposals are clearly identified.
- [ ] No secret, unauthorized material, sensitive setting change, or unapproved cost is introduced.
- [ ] Verification results are accurate.
- [ ] Required decisions and known limitations are documented.
- [ ] Founder authorization is still required before merge or deployment.
